title: ONE GRID, ONE RIGHT EDGE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus still look bad, take pictures and make it look like a triple A game. The picture review of the shop and the Mainframe found the item grid and the cream detail card floating in the middle of the window: in the shop a dead band about a sixth of the screen tall sat between the tabs and the first tile, and in both the detail card stopped well short of the right edge that the heading and the footer share. The grid now starts right under the tabs and runs the full width, so the detail card ends on the same right edge as everything else. Nothing else changed.
now: In the shop and the Mainframe the grid starts under the tabs and the detail card lines up with the right edge.
